_about: Pith M SMS template library, ported from the service design (draft 1, 21 Oct 2026). Variables use {{double_braces}}. {{brand}} comes from the client brain.

templates.text: {{brand}}: Thanks for joining our text alerts! Up to 4 msgs/mo. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, STOP to cancel. Terms: {{terms_link}}

{{brand}}: Help at {{support_contact}}. Up to 4 msgs/mo. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to cancel.
